answer_1.quote: We focus on two tasks of code representation learning: code summarization and completion ... Both tasks use the Python150k and JavaScript150k datasets.
answer_1.outputs: function names (summarization) and code tokens (type and value) for completion

answer_2.quote: Multiple metrics are used to comprehensively measure the quality of generated function names, including Bleu , F1 and Acc ... We measure MRR(mean reciprocal rank) and Acc for type and value.
